threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'shire' when asking for directions; proper locals know it's all about the 'cultural quarter' vibe now.
Saw a guy arguing with a traffic cone outside the Ritzy at 3 AM. He was convinced it was his old mate. Classic Brixton night.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy walking his pet iguana on a leash past the Tempelhofer Feld—only in Neukölln, right?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a hidden bar behind a laundromat where old vinyls play while folks sip cocktails served in vintage glasses.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they know the perfect time to dodge the BART delays—like when there’s a dog on the tracks and chaos at Civic Center.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a bus yesterday where the driver paused for a street performance. Turned into a mini concert, then we all cheered as the musician boarded. Classic SF vibe.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí. But if you wander into the back streets, the old independent shops and quirky bars are where the real charm is.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still taking photos of the Sagrada Familia at odd angles, trying to capture its 'real' beauty instead of just enjoying the view.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the 106 bus will get you anywhere on time. Bless your heart, but you’ll learn the hard way.
Saw a guy in a chicken suit singing 'I Will Survive' on the 35 last night. Only in Brixton would that be the least weird thing to happen.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw two guys on bikes negotiate a turf war over the best pizza share, all while dodging a runaway dog walking its owner.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a currywurst stand that opens at 3 AM for the late-night crowd, serving up grilled sausage with a side of techno beats.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows the exact moment when the BART delays hit peak chaos and can pivot to a taco truck before heading home.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo waiting for the 21 while balancing a whole cake. Only in SF do you dress up and still have your evening plans ride on Muni.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve tapas, but many Gràcia locals still prefer home-cooked meals. It's a real culinary pride thing, not just a convenience.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they’re still using Google Maps to navigate even the simplest streets - locals know the shortcuts.
